comparison.td01_source: Stage32 MAIN #1808 GRF-02 projected completion kernel
comparison.grf02_exact_theorem: A fixed x11 extends to some integral z53 iff x0+x4+x8+x10 == 0 (mod 2).
comparison.conclusion: Because both surfaces use the identical selected64 inverse and identical fixed/free matrices for the same extension problem, HPADJ09 HNF membership and the GRF-02 primitive parity equation define the same necessary completion gate. HPADJ09 is an independent exact derivation, not a stronger second filter to stack additively.

execution_comparison.td01: symbolic FULL178 HPADJ08 histogram refinement carrying one required x4 parity bit; bounded population-wide panel already measured
execution_comparison.hpadj09: generic exact HNF/Picard64 completion derivation; current bounded-panel implementation attempted direct PrefixMembershipOracle replay
execution_comparison.ex5_panel_failure: measurement script assumed check.modulus==2; retained terminal check reports modulus 8 even though the quotient has index 2
execution_comparison.reason: TD01 has already reduced the same exact gate to the primitive parity character and measured it on the entire retained low-degree counting panel without per-terminal Picard replay.

selection_policy.criterion: Prefer the route that reaches an audited exact FULL178 upper bound fastest; if two routes encode the same obstruction, reuse the stronger derivation and the cheaper population-counting implementation rather than duplicate scaleout.
selection_policy.current_choice: Use HPADJ09 as independent source-level confirmation and TD01 as the FULL178 counting implementation candidate.
selection_policy.future_stronger_ex5_gate: If EX5 later proves a strictly stronger completion predicate than the GRF-02 parity character, compare exact retained survivor bounds and switch to the stronger route if its cost is acceptable.
